mxCell.value: HDIP 0.1 — M15-V06: Product Consumption & Consumer Experience (SSCF / CEP)
From intent to value — governed discovery, access and consumption of Data, Information and Intelligence Products

Shows how Product Consumers discover, evaluate, access, consume and provide feedback through SSCF and CEP, with optional transition into PDEP when a new or evolved Product is intentionally constituted.
P1 - Governed Intent, Definition & Authority Context

Cross-Cutting Overlays (X1 - X9): Governance · Security/Identity · Provenance/Evidence · Observability · Quality/Fitness · Evaluation/Assurance · Lifecycle/Currentness · Resilience/Safety · Economic Accountability
HDIP Foundation (FND): shared compute, storage, network, messaging, registry, orchestration and runtime platform services
Eight canonical SSCF stages with CEP-mediated experiences, multiple entry modes and optional transition to PDEP
Consumer expresses intended outcome, purpose and context; HDIP creates or validates a CIR before governed resolution and access.
Consumer starts in Catalog / Marketplace. A governed intent context is still required before purpose-bound access is granted.
Existing valid CIR, Access Decision, Access Descriptor and Usage Contract may be reused when currentness and policy conditions remain satisfied.

Optional trigger for PDEP initiation
Discovery or consumption may reveal the need for a new or evolved Product. That transition is intentional and governed; Product discovery or reuse alone does not constitute a new Product.
CEP experience channels (illustrative): Web portal · Programmatic APIs · Interactive analytics · Applications / workflows · Integrated systems · Conversational / AI agent

• Discovery is purpose-neutral: it may support pure consumption or eventual Product creation.
• P2 supplies governed discovery/resolution capabilities; P4 presents consumer-facing discovery, selection, access and consumption experiences.
• CEP is a projection / experience composition, not a sixth Plane or a separate Product authority.
• Consumption does not automatically create a new Product; PDEP remains the authority for Product constitution or evolution.
• Agentic consumption does not by itself confer delegated consequential Decision or Action authority.
Artifacts and evidence in the consumer lifecycle

• CIR — Consumption Intent Record
• Product Resolution Set (candidate / resolved Products)
• Access Decision (ALLOW / DENY / CONDITIONAL)
• Access Descriptor and applicable Usage Contract
• Runtime execution / request records
• Usage, lineage, telemetry and audit evidence
• Feedback, outcome and value signals
